title: Widower's Nest Pot Luck II
description: Widower's Nest Pot Luck II — The Townstons wiki
html:
Quest Giver: Sir Tified Luhny

Quest Type: Collect

Quest Description: Collect some Mutated 'Rice' from Cancroidus the Oddshaped and an Orok 'Avocado' from the Emperor Orok and Report to Sir Tified Luhny on Level 5 of the Widower's Nest.

Quest Reward: Gold

Return to: Sir Tified Luhny

Repeatable: No

Following Quest: Widower's Nest Pot Luck II

Zone: The Widower's Nest

In-game text

Recovered from the Dungeon Runners client files. The notes above are from the old wiki when they exist.

Journal: Collect some Mutated 'Rice' from Cancroidus the Oddshaped and an Orok 'Avocado' from the Emperor Orok and Report to Sir Tified Luhny on Level 5 of the Widower's Nest.

Offer:

Ok, we need to whip up another dish for the Pot Luck here in the Widower's Nest and I think I have just the thing. Do you like sushi? Well, even if you did, you probably will be completely and utterly disgusted with what I have in mind.

First I need some rice. Being that there is no rice in the Widower's Nest, I need to get creative and I think I know what might work. Cancroidus the Oddshaped in the dungeon off of Level 5 of the Widower's Nest has some really odd growths on it's back and at least they look like rice. Grab some of those for me, please.

Next I am going to need some avocado, which also can't be found in the Widower's Nest. The next best thing, I think, would be the egg of an Orok. The male of the Orok species is known to keep an egg on them while the mother goes and tries to get some decent sleep and catch a movie. One such male has been seen in the dungeon off of Level 7 of the Widower's Nest and you should be able to find the Emperor Orok there.

When you have both the Mutated 'Rice' and the Orok 'Avocado' report to Sir Tified Luhny on Level 5 of the Widower's Nest.

Turn-in:

Oh, good, I was expecting you. Do you have the ingredients? Wonderful!

Objectives:

  • Mutated 'Rice' ×1
  • Orok 'Avocado' ×1

Client level range: 34–40
